basis: Defined by abnormal iris behavior during surgery.
Ingested iron directly causes corrosive gastrointestinal mucosal injury; hepatic failure and cardiovascular collapse occur in a severe minority.
Cerebellar disease, optic atrophy and skin abnormalities define CAMOS; renal insufficiency/nephrotic syndrome 30–79%; skin-vessel abnormalities omitted at four-axis cap.
Acute myeloid malignancy of blood-forming cells and bone marrow; GATA1 mutation does not establish additional organ involvement.
Cystic renal dysplasia, encephalocele and polydactyly define Meckel syndrome; hepatic ductal-plate malformation with fibrosis is common (>30%) across the syndrome.
Degeneration of the retinal macula causes central visual loss.
Definition specifies fissuring and inflammation of skin at the mouth corners; an infectious or autoimmune cause is not inherent to the umbrella concept.
Malignancy occupies the paranasal sinuses, included in the airway axis; skull or neural invasion is not universal.
Tumor consists of ectopic adrenal cortical endocrine tissue, despite its testicular or ovarian location.
Congenital failure of talar fragments to fuse causes a structural bone and ankle disorder.
Congenital abnormal origin of a pulmonary artery from the ductus arteriosus; pulmonary arteries belong to the vascular axis.
Teratoma originates in the testis or ovary; reproductive tumor location alone has no axis.
Theca-type gonadal stromal tumor arises from steroid-producing endocrine cells and is commonly estrogenic; associated reproductive cancers are separate diseases.
Tumor directly occupies the central nervous system or dura; adjacent bone involvement is not required across the concept.
Autoimmune blood disorder defined by platelet depletion; ancestors and children establish its immune mechanism.
Renal hypoplasia/aplasia and middle-ear ossicular anomalies with hearing impairment define the syndrome; genital abnormalities have no axis.
Isolated breast/nipple aplasia or hypoplasia has no axis; choanal atresia occurs only occasionally (5–29%).
ADHD is a neurodevelopmental disorder, explicitly covered by the neurologic axis.
Clonal lymphocyte malignancy establishes the blood-cell axis; lymphoma explicitly receives the immune axis. No extranodal organ is common across the umbrella.
Inherited skin pigmentation disorder; oral pigmentation does not establish gastrointestinal tissue damage or impaired function.
Definition emphasizes amoebic meningoencephalitis; infectious encephalitis occurs in 30–79%. Visual loss is occasional (5–29%); photophobia alone is insufficient.
Neoplasm of lymph-node tissue within the hematopoietic/lymphoid system; the broad category does not necessarily establish lymphoma or an immune mechanism.
B-cell lymphoma directly occupies the thyroid endocrine gland; lymphoid malignancy and lymphoma mechanism supply the other primary axes.
Inherited cerebellar degeneration defines the disease; cataracts directly affect the eyes in 2/2 reported patients.
Congenital muscular dystrophy with defining brain and eye malformations; lissencephaly 6/6, cataracts 4/6 and microphthalmia 3/6 support these axes.
